specification.problem: Estimate the influence of each variable x_i on an n-variable Boolean function f using the quantum Bernstein-Vazirani circuit: after one run, the probability of reading 1 in position i equals the influence of x_i on f. Use repeated runs to approximate influences, and apply this to learning juntas.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Abstract-level reconstruction of the influence-estimation claim and approximation algorithm; the junta-learning algorithms and their complexity are not detailed. A small finite instance with n qubits plus an ancilla is assumed.

symbols.meaning: i-th bit of the Bernstein-Vazirani output y
influence (dependence degree) of x_i on f

equations.label: Bit probability equals influence
equations.description: One-run probability of a 1 in position i equals the influence of x_i on f.
equations.abstract_quote: the probability of getting a 1 in each position $i$ is equal to the dependence degree of $f$ on the variable $x_{i}$, i.e. the influence of $x_{i}$ on $f$

equations.label: BV output distribution
equations.description: Standard output distribution of the BV circuit applied to a phase oracle for f.

equations.label: Influence in Fourier form
equations.description: Standard Fourier expression for influence, consistent with eq_1 and eq_2.
equations.justification: Standard Boolean analysis with the normalization Inf_i = Pr[f(x)!=f(x xor e_i)]/2-type scaling; combining with eq_2 gives eq_1 under the paper's definition.
assumptions: Influence normalized so that it equals the sum of squared Fourier weight on s_i=1

equations.label: Empirical estimate
equations.justification: Natural sampling estimator for the approximation algorithm; the exact scheme is not given in the abstract.

registers.name: x
registers.role: Input register for the BV circuit, measured to give y

registers.name: anc
registers.role: Ancilla in |-> for phase kickback from the oracle U_f (assumed standard BV form)

specification.initial_state: |0>^{n} on x and |1> on anc (before Hadamards)

steps.description: Apply H^{\otimes n} to x and H to anc, giving uniform superposition on x and |-> on anc.
Apply oracle U_f, imprinting phase (-1)^{f(x)} on x by kickback.
Apply H^{\otimes n} to x, so outcome y is distributed as the squared Fourier coefficients.
Repeat the circuit N times independently to collect samples for estimation.

specification.measurement: Measure the x register in the computational basis after the final Hadamards to obtain y; the bit y_i is a Bernoulli sample with mean Inf_i(f).
specification.classical_postprocessing: Over N independent runs, average y_i per position to estimate Inf_i(f) (eq_4); variables with estimate near 0 are treated as irrelevant when seeking juntas (assumed thresholding).
assumptions: Sampling estimator is the intended approximation
Ancilla prepared in |1> then Hadamard to give |->
Thresholding rule for junta identification is assumed, not given
Thresholding on estimated influences is the assumed junta-identification step
missing_information: Measurement and postprocessing are inferred, not stated in abstract
Abstract does not specify error/confidence parameters for the approximation
